catalog.notes: Nine-image manual tutorial for cDNA-vs-genomic comparison. The March 2026 images are useful orientation captures but predate provenance-bound GUI acceptance; the inner agent uses current GUI state, while outer replay requires explicit state, network and genome-cache paths.
